title.rendered: Harvest Festival at Red Berry Barn

content.rendered:
Harvest Festival- A Public Family Event- Wednesday, October 22, 2025 from 4:00 – 6:00 pm!

We are excited to announce that this year we will be partnering with Sherwood Red Berry Barn this year to host our Harvest Festival off-site.

Red Berry Barn admission is required for everyone to access any part of the farm grounds. Children 1 year and younger are free when accompanied with a paying adult. Tickets are available for purchase until 5:00 pm at the event-be sure to mention SCS to receive a discounted rate! In addition to the Harvest Festival activities they offer, they also have food available to purchase, including Polish dogs, Hot dogs, PB&J, Homemade chili, Nachos and bakery items.

Hope to see you there!
